blurb: Approach Tours offers multi-day group tours to various international destinations, focusing on immersive cultural and natural experiences. Tours range from 13 to 20 days and include destinations such as Australia, Antarctica, Ecuador, France, Costa Rica, Iceland, New Zealand, Spain, Japan, and Thailand. The company emphasizes all-inclusive travel with door-to-door service and comfort.

Loved my first experience with Approach tours on the trip, Splendours of Spain! Everything about the trip seemed flawless and exciting to see! Annette was our Guru and she made the trip totally stress free, flawless and very enjoyable! We flew into Madrid and travelled to Toledo, Cordoba, Sevilla, Malaga, Valencia, Sitges, and Barcelona! The trip to Italy was wonderful. Everything was well organized and thoughfully planned out. Guru Rasha was very considerate of individual needs and attentive to everyone. Our Italian Guide was lovely! She was very knowledgeable and informative. We had 23 travellers which made us like a family. We made many frienships and had an enjoyable time with Approach T…

Overall the tour was excellent. Both the group guru and national guru were great, and the bus drivers were also fantastic. The only negative was some of the hotels were not to the level I expected. More of a comment than a complaint is that for both lunches and dinners there was far too much food, and we felt bad leaving so many leftovers on our plates.

Great National Guide, Great Local guides, Great Guru whilst on trip. Loved every city I visited and every bus was on time with great drivers. Each major Venue visited was mind blowing and exciting. Food was amazing with lots of wine.soft drinks. (90%) of the hotels were great.
